hypothesis: Paired-profile DEM throw persistence: repeated, polarity-consistent cross-strike elevation steps on Band 12 det_elev, constrained by Band 19 det_elev_slope, could identify subtle unmapped scarps.
mechanism: A true fault scarp can produce a signed step between footwall and hanging-wall baselines that persists across neighboring profiles and scales; this differs from an unsigned slope-break coherence score or a local fall-line curvature score.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Lake Lahontan shoreline risers, alluvial-fan margins, channel banks, and lithologic contacts can create persistent non-tectonic elevation steps.

holdout_dti.reason: No candidate feature surface was constructed or scored. The 19-band feature stack is absent from .cache/gems_inputs/, and the literal registry witness fails the pre-placement gate before any build.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.policy: absolute Spearman > 0.90 OR > 70% of candidate dots within 3 px of one registry raster means duplicate; no density exemption applied

existing_primary_measurement.scope: Measured on an already-existing research artifact; not a newly built candidate, not a full-registry scan, and not a pre-placement-surface rerun.

preplacement_surface.basis: Set-theoretic implication from the witness receipt: every footprint cell is positive in the witness, so any in-footprint positive surface cell is coincident with a witness positive cell. No candidate-specific surface measurement is claimed.

final_dots.basis: The same full-support witness makes every in-footprint dot coincide with a positive witness cell. No new candidate dots were emitted.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.scope_limit: A prior GitHub-blob-verified single-witness receipt is decisive for rejection but is not a fresh exhaustive registry scan.

validator_output.reason: No new raster exists to validate. On the reviewed tree, scripts/check_site.py independently rereads and gates all 15 existing served zeros-outside rasters; that validates those existing research files only.

verdict_detail: No experiment and no TIFF were generated because the literal pre-placement uniqueness gate is unsatisfiable for nonempty predictions under the existing full-footprint witness. Existing downloads are for research only; none is cleared for a weekly slot.
